title.th: คำสั่งค่าธรรมเนียม (กระทรวงกลาโหม)

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Ministry of Defence) Order.

2. There shall be payable to the Ministry of Defence in respect of replacements of the items specified in the first column of the Schedule the fees specified opposite thereto in the second column thereof.
[S 640/2024 wef 01/08/2024]

3. The Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Defence may remit wholly or in part any fee payable under this Order.
[S 673/2023 wef 20/10/2023]
